data.name: Transmutation Opposition School
data.description: You have chosen transmutation spells as an opposition school. Preparing an transmutation spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has an transmutation spell as a prerequisite.
